forum.title: Function AFERead16BitBuffer() function in afe_config.c does not return a status
forum.best_answer_content:
In AFERead16BitBuffer(), it looks like the receive result is getting ignored. You set status from HAL\_SPI\_Transmit(), but HAL\_SPI\_Receive() runs without assigning its return value back to status.

So this line:

HAL\_SPI\_Receive(&hSPI, (uint8\_t \*)&pData[0], 2 \* numSamples, SPI\_TIMEOUT);

could probably be:

status = HAL\_SPI\_Receive(&hSPI, (uint8\_t \*)&pData[0], 2 \* numSamples, SPI\_TIMEOUT);

That would make the function report a receive failure properly, same as the 32-bit version. Also worth being careful with the endian swap and debug print after a failed receive, since the buffer may not contain valid data in that case.

Pavel’s point about CRC is worth checking too, but the missing status assignment in the 16-bit path does look like a real bug either way.
